title: Replication
coreMove: Preserve the working structure through transfer, not the surface ritual that merely looks copied.
sourcePressure: Replication concerns persistence through copying, transmission, reproduction, or passing structure onward.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: equating replication with exact repetition or copy-paste sameness

hook: opening with a definition of Replication
counterintuition: equating replication with exact repetition or copy-paste sameness
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
